title: Perp RSI
description: Relative strength of the perpetual over the last fourteen one-minute bars, from zero to one hundred. It compares the size of recent gains with recent losses.

rsi_14.label: RSI
rsi_14.description: Recent gains against recent losses on a scale from zero to one hundred. Above seventy is stretched to the upside, below thirty to the downside.

regime.label: RSI zone
regime.description: Overbought above seventy, oversold below thirty, neutral in between. Stretched readings tend to come back.
